quotes.text: He must have a long spoon that must eat with the devil.

A measure that will fit into a spoon; a spoonful.

senses.definition: (fishing) A type of metal lure resembling the concave head of a tablespoon.

senses.definition: (US, military) A safety handle on a hand grenade, a trigger.

quotes.text: We therefore have to meticulously plan out each day with the small amount of spoons we have. Each task will cost us at least one spoon.

senses.definition: To serve using a spoon; to transfer (something) with a spoon.

quotes.text: By the light of the silvery moon, / I want to spoon, / To my honey I'll croon love's tune, […]
